description: Withdraws a scheduled post before it goes out, so nothing is sent; the post answers `cancelled` and its video can be prepared and scheduled again. WHEN: the user asks to cancel or replace a scheduled post (a wrong video, caption or time). ONLY A TIKTOK OR INSTAGRAM POST AICUT STILL HOLDS: `scheduled` with `schedule_custody: aicut_scheduler`. A scheduled YouTube post cannot be cancelled here: it is already uploaded and YouTube holds it, so the user changes or deletes it in YouTube Studio. A post due within a minute, or one the scheduler has picked up, is already being sent and is refused. Cancel only a post the user named in this session, in their own words. To change only the time, use `publish_post` with a new `schedule_at` instead. 403 `insufficient_scope` = the user's connection lacks the `social:publish` permission: not a bad `video_id` or `account_id`, and a retry cannot fix it. Tell them to disconnect and reconnect aicut at https://www.aicut.pro/account/settings#connections (the full steps are in `prepare_post`'s REFUSALS), then STOP.

post_id.description: The `id` of the scheduled post, as `prepare_post` returned it.
